_readme: Starter file for the 'Official MiniMax template' recipe. Copy the entry into your own recipes.json - the prompt-enhancer panel shows the exact path on every machine - then edit it. 'key' must be a name the pack does not already use, 'label' is what the dropdown shows, and 'block' is the shape instruction the enhancer sends. Anything you delete is inherited from 'based_on'.

recipes.label: My Official MiniMax template
recipes.summary: Leave the shape to MiniMax's own task template (the behaviour before recipes existed).
recipes.block:
Shape the answer as the calling task's own MiniMax template asks for it: an editing
instruction followed by a detailed description of the target video. Do not restructure the
input into labelled sections if it is not already written that way, and do not flatten
labelled lines if it is.
